comment: The one set of cases the bridge's pane-name.ts and the web's web/src/lib/pane-name.ts BOTH run. Two mirrored copies of one rule stay honest only while they answer the same fixtures; bridge/pane-name.test.ts and web/src/lib/pane-name.test.ts each read this file. Add a case here, never to one side alone.

names.case: a label the operator gave through Collie outranks everything
names.name: release notes

names.case: Claude's own /rename name outranks the title it rewrites every turn
names.name: workflow-gate-commits

names.case: a named tab that holds the pane alone names it, above the title Claude writes
names.name: Ui fixes

names.case: a /rename still outranks the one-pane tab's name
names.name: plumbing

names.case: an older peer that sends no tab name keeps the title
names.name: Fact check ritual

names.case: an auto title is the name when nobody set one
names.name: Collie playground sync check

names.case: a stale title names nothing, so an agent pane falls back to its agent word
names.name: claude

names.case: an agent pane with no name of any kind reads as its agent
names.name: codex

names.case: a bare shell reads as shell, whatever its agent field says
names.name: shell

names.case: a labelled shell keeps the operator's label
names.name: logs
